orchestration.label: Orchestration and compliance

foundation.title: Foundation
foundation.audience: Recommended for SMEs with a limited fleet (5–30 workloads). Simple backup/restore.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.audience: Recommended for SMEs with a larger fleet (30–150 workloads). Fine-grained monitoring and proactive alerts.

premium.title: Premium
premium.audience: Recommended for mid-size and large enterprises with an extensive fleet (150–2000+ workloads). DR orchestration and compliance.

service_name.label: Service name
service_name.hint: Identifier for your VBR server in the OVHcloud Control Panel.
service_name.error: We just need the name of your service.

public_ip.label: Public IP address
public_ip.hint: The public IP address of your VBR server.

veeam_client_ip.label: Veeam Client IP address
veeam_client_ip.hint: The public IP address of the machine where your Veeam Client will be executed (optional if you're using the client directly on the VBR).

private_ip.label: Private IP address (LAN)
private_ip.hint: Local IP address of your VBR server on the internal network.

vault_name.label: Vault name
vault_name.hint: Identifier for your Vault in the Control Panel. Cannot be changed after creation.

nat.toggle_title: My Veeam server is behind a NAT

nat.callout: OVHcloud will use the NAT public IP to reach your server, the private IP will be used to identify your server in our console.
